Name: Area 52 Summertime Extraterrestrial Commerce
Author: CosmicSweetpea
Description:
[b][size=4]Area 52 Summertime Extraterrestrial Vendor by CosmicSweetpea[/size][/b]

[size=3]I spent a huge amount of time drawing the artwork, building the shop, creating the items, testing everything. This mod was a massive labor of love, and I am incredibly excited to finally share it with you. 🌈🛸👽 [/size]

[color=#d4d4d8]A mysterious UFO has established a temporary summer business on Pelican Town’s beach during the summer. Area 52 adds a seasonal alien vendor, a custom NPC named Vesper, alien crops, foods, recipes, artisan products, furniture, clothing, antennae, and one highly restricted plasma weapon. Visit throughout summer to discover rotating Tuesday and Thursday inventories, grow a small extraterrestrial agricultural economy, and purchase objects that probably have not been approved by Mayor Lewis.[/color]
[line]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Vesper’s Summer Schedule[/color][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Vesper only appears during summer. Monday, Wednesday, and Friday Vesper spends the day on the beach.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Tuesday and Thursday the Area 52 UFO shop is open on the beach.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Saturday and Sunday Vesper visits the Stardrop Saloon after 5:00 PM. The shop carries different inventory depending on the day. Some specialty items have limited stock.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]The shop carries different inventory depending on the day. Some specialty items have limited stock.[/color]

[b]Credits and Permissions[/b]

[b]🖼️ — ARTWORK & USAGE — 🎨[/b]

All artwork included in this mod was created by me. Please do not reuse, edit, reupload, redistribute, sell, or include my artwork or files in another mod without my explicit permission.

[b]👽 — THE AI TAG — 👽[/b]

[b]Download the mod or do not. You may decide for yourself how seriously any of this should be taken.[/b]

[i]I am using this tag on all of my mods, regardless of how the individual assets were made. I made this decision after people began applying the AI label to my work based on assumption, regardless of how the individual assets were actually created. The tag is not a confession that every asset was generated by AI. It is a tongue-in-cheek response to every mod page now needing to double as a courtroom exhibit proving that its creator possesses motor skills, because I have apparently reached the stage of my twenty-year creative career where strangers require a forensic investigation before believing a human like myself can actually create. I have decided to save everyone the trouble and tag the entire catalogue. Thank you to the concerned citizens who helped me discover this.[/i]
